name: CITY GHOST: AR Urban Exploration Challenge
description: A community-developed AR game built on open-source BCI protocols that challenges players to locate and document hidden or forgotten spaces within GLMZ — sealed transit tunnels, decommissioned infrastructure nodes, pre-Collapse architectural remnants — using a shared AR layer that records and verifies discoveries. Points are awarded for genuine discovery, historical documentation quality, and the difficulty of access. CITY GHOST has no corporate sponsor and is maintained entirely by volunteer developers and the contributions of its 200,000-strong player community.
story_hooks: A CITY GHOST player discovers a sealed room containing pre-Collapse records that a corponation has been paying to keep buried — and the community must decide what to do with the knowledge.
Someone is using CITY GHOST's verified discovery routes as a map for something other than exploration, and players keep finding evidence of recent passage in spaces that shouldn't have been visited.
The game's lead developer goes missing after announcing a 'discovery of the decade' — leaving only a set of AR coordinates and a cryptic note in the community archive.
